test_cases.question:
Here's a technical question that can be answered using only the information in the provided text:

What is the effect on Pod distribution if you set podAntiAffinity to requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution mode?

This question requires knowledge of Kubernetes concepts, specifically the behavior of podAntiAffinity, and can be definitively answered based on the text.
test_cases.ground_truth: According to the provided text, if you set podAntiAffinity to requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution mode, then only a single Pod can be scheduled into a single topology domain. This means that the Pods will be repelled from each other and distributed across different topology domains in order to satisfy this constraint.

Answer: The Kubernetes control plane waits until an updated Pod is Running and Ready prior to updating its predecessor.
